workflow.name: Client Onboarding
workflow.description: End-to-end client onboarding workflow for EEVL — from lead capture through project kickoff. The onboarding-agent sub-agent handles the entire kickoff sequence automatically.

tasks.name: Lead Capture & Qualification
tasks.description: Detect incoming leads via GHL forms or website, auto-respond within 60 seconds via SMS, qualify and score leads, create CRM records, and trigger nurture sequences.

sla.description: SMS auto-response must fire within 60 seconds of lead capture — this is a hard SLA.

tasks.name: Sales Call & Follow-Up
tasks.description: Record and transcribe sales calls via MeetingScribe, generate Notion summaries, create ClickUp follow-up tasks, update GHL pipeline, and draft proposals.

tasks.name: Contract & Invoice Generation
tasks.description: Generate PandaDoc contracts from approved proposals, track e-signatures, create Stripe invoices, sync to QuickBooks, and send receipts via Gmail.

tasks.name: Project Kickoff & Workspace Setup
tasks.description: Create ClickUp project from template, set up Lark channel and Notion workspace, send kickoff email, and assign team members. The onboarding-agent sub-agent orchestrates this entire sequence.

triggers.description: Fires when a new lead is captured via GHL form submission or website chat widget.
Manual trigger for onboarding a client who came through a non-automated channel (referral, in-person meeting, etc.).

sub_agents.name: Onboarding Agent
sub_agents.description: Handles the entire project kickoff sequence automatically — workspace creation, channel setup, email dispatch, and team assignment. Orchestrates all kickoff sub-tasks without manual intervention.

sub_agents.name: MeetingScribe
sub_agents.description: Records, transcribes, and summarizes sales calls. Extracts key discussion points and action items.
